opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: up to £750 (Scheme B co‑sponsored award) or up to £300 (Scheme C) or up to £200 (Scheme A)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate, Master's and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva (Scheme A also open to under‑grads). UK‑based members for non‑UK conferences; non‑UK members for UK conferences. One grant per two years for Schemes B/C.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at genetics‑related conferences (Society‑organised, other meetings or virtual conferences) by providing travel, accommodation and registration funding.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK (students eligible immediately; others need at least one‑year membership). Must be UK‑based for training courses or collaborative visits.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short formal training courses or collaborative laboratory visits to acquire genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students eligible immediately; others need at least one‑year membership.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel and accommodation for field‑based genetic research projects that aim for results suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: several thousand pounds; typical sponsorship levels £1,000–£2,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member (any career stage) wishing to organise a genetics‑themed meeting in the UK. Applications can be submitted any time; recommended three months in advance.
opportunities.summary: Provides sponsorship for one‑off genetics meetings not directly organised by the Society, covering venue, speaker travel, and optional Carer’s Awards.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society. Grants support public‑engagement activities (in‑person or virtual) related to genetics.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,000 for travel and material costs to deliver public engagement activities, with two annual deadlines (1 Mar and 1 Oct).
